{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ackbar Trail''' was a secret network of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ships, safe houses and hidden pathways that allowed [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to escape their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] after [[Darth Krayt]] began the [[Genocide on Dac]]. The Ackbar Trail transported refugees to isolated [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds and even planets in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] where they could escape the wrath of the [[One Sith]]. The Trail was named after [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], who escaped [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] at the hands of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] to lead the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] that eventually defeated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] Tarkin had served.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
